builds.name: devkit
builds.description: Arrhythmia 0.1.1. Unchanged from 0.1.0. Image 7228, pinned by SHA-256. Image 7228 itself is not tested on hardware. A development build that differs from it only in the scales code and the build number had a short hardware test 2026-10-19 (install, version reply, no DSP fault, SysEx 7D restriction and meter read); no listening or stress test. For developers: the DSP load meter and its read command, the module loader and SDK, scales for tracks 1 to 7 (set over SysEx only) and the p-lock fix. Track 8 stays a stock sample track in this image.
